items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Norma, Toby and Harold would vie for the position as “The Best Piano Player in Town”

ctx.x: No way before Ketter. I can’t think of his name now but he is mentioned in Buck Clayton’s autobiography. Both of those guys, Streamline and… because I think they were in the army together and they were around the same age. But they were… these were musicians who were natives of Washington and/or getting… some other people I ought to mention as the good players of that period, I mentioned Norma Shepherd but also Hal Francis who later became fairly well known as the accompanist for the Ink spots. He never got his……
Let me ask you about another trumpet player that came from Washington, his name was Webster Young and they called him Little Diz. Did you know him?
